title: feat(spec): requiredPermissions on ListViewSchema and DashboardSchema, the audience gate, planned until the /meta read gate applies it (#22611)
body:
Fixes #22611
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## Summary

The spec half of the ruling of record `6095014058` on #22611 (letter A). `ListViewSchema` and `DashboardSchema` each gain `requiredPermissions`, the platform's one audience key. It has the shape and meaning the app, navigation-item, action (ADR-0066 D4) and record-block keys already carry: `z.array(z.string()).optional()`, a list of capabilities, all required, no default. The two keys share one describe word for word. There is no any-of form; B was not taken. "Or" is one capability granted to several permission sets, and the docs say so where `requiredPermissions` is taught.

**Declared is enforced, so the window says so.** No server reads either key until #22639 (`Blocked-by: #22611`) lands the `/meta` read-gate half. Three things carry that fact:

- the liveness rows are `planned`, carrier #22639, with `authorWarn` and an `authorHint` (no tracker number in the hint);
- the describe ends with a `[PLANNED — not enforced yet]` clause that names no door as enforcing today;
- the Studio forms offer no control for either key. This follows the repo's precedent for planned keys (`object.externalSharingModel`, `page.print`, `field.conditionalFormatting`): two `omit` rows in the form/Zod reconciliation ledger.

This PR edits nothing under `packages/rest/**`, `packages/runtime/**` or any server package. `ListViewSchema.sharing` (ownership and locking) is untouched.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/audience-required-permissions.ts` (new; outside the `ui` barrel, the `view-history.ts` / `list-view-export-options.ts` precedent, so it is not published API): `AUDIENCE_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION`, the one describe. Its docblock explains each clause.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `requiredPermissions` is added on `ListViewShapeSchema`. It therefore reaches every list-view door built from that shape: `ListViewSchema`, `ObjectListViewSchema` (a container's `list` / `listViews`, an object's `listViews`), the view item's `config` and the flattened list overlay.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`: `requiredPermissions` on `DashboardSchema`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` (`list.children.requiredPermissions`) and `dashboard.json` (`requiredPermissions`): `planned`, `verifiedAt` 2026-10-10, `authorWarn: true`, an `authorHint`, and a note that names the carrier and the flip condition. Also: README state-table notes for both types, and regenerated `state-counts/` (view 0 to 1 planned, dashboard 0 to 1 planned).
- Generated: `authorable-surface/ui.json` (+3: `ui/Dashboard`, `ui/ListView` and `ui/ObjectListView` `:requiredPermissions`) and `content/docs/references/**` (10 rows: `ui/view.mdx` 6, `api/protocol.mdx` 2, `ui/dashboard.mdx` 1, `data/object.mdx` 1). After the second merge of `origin/main`, `references/ui/view.mdx` was regenerated from the merged tree. The os-regen driver had kept this branch's bytes and dropped main's `editInline` default flip (#22629); the regeneration commit restores it beside this branch's rows.
- `content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx`: a short section, "Or is one capability, granted twice", with the CLM shape (`clm_legal_workbench.view` granted to `clm_legal` and `clm_admin`), the AND trap, and a callout that the list-view and dashboard key is not enforced yet. It names no tracker number.
- `.changeset/22611-list-view-dashboard-required-permissions.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, naming #22639 as the enforcing half.
- Pins: `packages/spec/src/ui/audience-required-permissions.test.ts` (new), and two ledger rows in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`. In `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`, a real-ledger block.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured at `origin/main` `1b99388505`

1. **Shape.** The app navigation item (`app.zod.ts:364`), `AppSchema` (`:1593`), `ActionSchema` (`action.zod.ts:1536`) and the four record blocks (`component.zod.ts`, `RECORD_BLOCK_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION`) are all `z.array(z.string()).optional()`. No shared schema or exported constant exists: the record-block describe is module-private and states presentation-only semantics, so it fits neither key. So one describe constant was declared, for the two new keys only. No existing describe was touched.
2. **Refused before.** A tsx probe on `src`: `ListViewSchema`, `ObjectListViewSchema` and `DashboardSchema` each answered `unrecognized_keys` `[requiredPermissions]`. `AppSchema` with the same key parsed (the positive control). No alias table on either schema maps `requiredPermissions` or the near-misses (`permissions`, `requiredPermission`, `requiredpermission`, `capabilities`). All four are refused as unknown keys, and this PR adds no alias.
3. **No reader exists, so `planned` is the true verdict.**
   - `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` reads `requiredPermissions` only on an app and its navigation entries (`filterAppForUserWithReason`, `:740`, `:757`). The dashboard arms gate widgets on `requiresService` only.
   - `packages/runtime` reads it for actions and apps.
   - `packages/lint` `validate-capability-references.ts` resolves objects, fields, apps and actions.
   - objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `20c6d351ad74` has zero reads under `plugin-list`, `plugin-view` and `plugin-dashboard`. The lit control is `layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`, with 7 hits.
   - The console dist is not built in this checkout, so its source at the pin is the reading.
4. **Lint path.** Two reachable spellings warn: an authored `dashboards[].requiredPermissions` (a top-level row), and an authored `views[].list.requiredPermissions` (one level of `children`). A container's named `listViews.NAME` entry is not walked (the lint flattens one level), nor is an object's `listViews`. That is why the describe carries the not-enforced clause too. No schema default materializes the key, and "absent stays absent" is pinned.
5. **Forms.** `app.form.ts` and `action.form.ts` offer `requiredPermissions` because those gates are enforced. For a planned key the repo's pattern is no form control plus a reconciliation-ledger `omit` row, and this PR follows that pattern.
   - `dashboard` is object-rooted, so the top-level zod-only direction requires the row: without it, that test reds.
   - `view` is union-rooted (`TOP_LEVEL_DEFERRED`). It gets the same row for symmetry.

## Verification (head `af81d59c30`)

Measured after the last commit. `git rev-parse --short HEAD` = `af81d59c30`.

**Build.** The dependency closure was built with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' build`, spec included: exit 0. There was no whole-workspace build.

**Tests and typechecks**, each through `os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run --project local` gave **643 files, 19184 passed** (1 todo). `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, the scripts typecheck, `check:test-typecheck`) exited 0: "52 file(s) / 246 error(s) / 135 pinned signature(s) held", which is the existing ledger, unchanged.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `vitest run` gave **134 files, 6135 passed**. `typecheck` exited 0.
- The new pins on their own: `audience-required-permissions.test.ts` plus `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` gave 89 passed. The lint real-ledger block gave 3 passed (`-t 'audience gate'`).

**Consumer reverse check (one-shot).** I used a probe file under `packages/lint/src` that resolves `@objectstack/spec/ui` through the rebuilt `dist` `.d.ts`:

- a `Dashboard` and a `ListView` literal carrying `requiredPermissions` type-check, exit 0;
- the same literal spelled `requiredPermission` is refused with `TS2561`, exit 2. So the consumer reads the rebuilt declarations.

The probe was deleted, and `git status` is clean.

**Generated artifacts.**

- `check:generated`: "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `check:liveness`: green. Its census reads "author warnings: 4 ledger row(s) opt into `authorWarn` … (planned 4); 0 on a `live` row": the two existing rows plus these two.
- `check:nul-bytes`: OK.

**Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived 111 commands at `af81d59c30` (18 paths against merge base `3d0eeefa4`). Reconciled with `--ran` and an exit-annotated record: "111 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 109 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED".

- 108 of the 109 run exited 0.
- `check:platform-checklist` exited 1 with 7 problems. It is red on `origin/main` too: a clean `origin/main` `5fb1746611` worktree gives the same 7. The citations in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` and `attachments-storage.json` name symbols that left `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `service-storage`. This diff touches none of those files.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (it needs a whole-workspace build) and `check:type-check-debt` (its `--re-measure` runs `turbo run build` over every package). The dispatch forbids both. CI runs them.

**Artifact rosters.** The 48 roster commands that need no PR context: 47 exited 0, and `check:published-readme-exports` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 17 packages whose type entries it reads are not built. That is NOT MEASURED; this diff edits no README and no export of those packages. The 3 PR-context guards (`check-closing-target-claim.mjs`, `check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs`, `check-single-claim-paths.mjs`) run against this PR once it exists; their results are in the report comment.

**Not measured locally, declared to CI.** These are the type-check lanes (`turbo run typecheck` over every package, the examples, and `downstream-contract`) and the path-scheduled CI jobs. They are additive optional keys: a grep for exhaustive `keyof ListView` / `keyof Dashboard` typing over `packages`, `apps` and `examples` finds none.

## Ablation (one-shot, not kept)

Committed state `f449ed3aac`. The mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete -- …`, deleting the `DashboardSchema` declaration line. The anchor hit once (x1 to x0), and the blob moved from `6e7bebcde6c2` to `f99584c01a42`. The subject resolves through relative imports to `src`, so no build or dist preflight applies.

- Mutated: `vitest run src/ui/audience-required-permissions.test.ts src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` gave **6 failed / 83 passed**:
  - the three `DashboardSchema` door pins;
  - the one-text identity pin;
  - the app-shape pin;
  - the reconciliation ledger's "every ledger entry still resolves on both sides" (the dashboard `omit` row no longer resolves).
- The `ListViewSchema` / `ObjectListViewSchema` / container pins stayed green, as expected.
- Direction: red, the common case.
- Restored: the blob after restore equals the HEAD blob `6e7bebcde6c2`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty (the tool's own verdict, re-read by hand).

## Acceptance notes

- **Handoff to #22639 (the object door).** `requiredPermissions` reaches an object's own `listViews` through `ObjectListViewSchema`. Those entries are served inside the object definition, not as `/meta/view` items: no server package expands `objects[].listViews`. #22639 names the `/meta/view` and dashboard reads only. The same question is in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Handoff to #22639 (the flip).** One edit flips both liveness rows to `live`, drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint`, and deletes the describe's `[PLANNED — not enforced yet]` clause. The two lint warn pins here turn red at that flip on purpose; re-subject them to the silence.
- **Lint boundary (no filing).** `validateCapabilityReferences` (`packages/lint`) resolves `requiredPermissions` on objects, fields, apps and actions, not on a list view or dashboard. Once the gate is enforced, a misspelled capability there would hide the item from everyone without a warning. Carrier: #22639, or the seat. Nothing reads the key today, so nothing fails yet.
- **Observation (no filing; the ruling keeps `sharing` as it is).** `ViewSharingSchema`'s docblock reads "Defines who can see and modify a view", and its describe reads "View sharing and access configuration". The ruling records `sharing` as ownership and locking, not audience. An author could read the wording as an audience gate.
- `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` are NOT MEASURED locally: the first one's `--re-measure` runs `turbo run build` over every package, and the second needs a whole-workspace build. The dispatch forbids both. During the first gate pass that turbo build clobbered `packages/spec/dist` mid-run, so I killed it (my own PIDs). Every gate whose run overlapped the rebuild window was re-run after a clean closure build. CI runs both.
